claim_boundary: This one-acetone gas-phase source-representer falsifier constructs a full neutral transition-density response directly from a frozen spherical atomic Hartree--Fock independent-particle table. Its response covariance is completed solely to the already frozen MACE-MDP molecular dipole covariance and audited atom-dipole partition, then compared with independent fixed-geometry QM finite-field electronic potential at all 516 immutable exterior points. It invokes no continuum, PCM energy, implicit solvent, experimental solvation label, parameter fit, model-weight update, force/PES claim, total solvation calculation, or public Route-2 profile. A pass can admit only this exact gas-phase source to a later same-basis common-scalar/KKT gate; it cannot establish chemical accuracy.
decision_rule: If any numerical or scientific gate fails, reject this exact frozen atomic independent-particle source candidate. Do not alter transition selection, orbitals, response weights, source points, MACE weights, atom partition, polarizability, continuum, or gate after observing QM-MEP error. Do not add fitted density modes, induced monopoles, empirical damping, response rescaling/clipping/symmetrization, a solvation label, or an accuracy panel. A pass permits only a separately preregistered same-basis common-scalar/KKT, continuum-duality, and force gate; it does not establish a final molecular density, electronic functional, total solvation method, or experimental solvation accuracy.

scientific_falsification_gates.interpretation: These frozen 0.20/0.30 gates are copied unchanged from the earlier one-radial induced-source and QEq gas-response falsifiers. They reject a grossly inaccurate source representation without selecting this candidate. Passing remains insufficient for a molecular energy functional, continuum coupling, force, PES, or experimental solvation claim.

source_representation.atomic_response: All positive occupation-over-gap transition densities of frozen spherical AtomSphAverageRHF def2-TZVPD H/C/N/O/S/Cl; each is intrinsically neutral by orbital orthogonality.
source_representation.completion: C=C0-LS0L^T+L(W alpha W^T)L^T with S0=A C0 A^T and L=C0 A^T S0^-1; this is the pre-existing no-fit V0-RK moment completion.
source_representation.molecular_response: The frozen MACE-MDP canonical polarizability and raw audited atom-dipole partition are used only as fixed dipole-moment constraints after their prior gates; no MACE density is called an electron density.
source_representation.potential: delta V_e(s)=-sum_m x_m integral tau_m(r)/|r-s|dr, x=-C f, and f_m,k=integral tau_m(r)r_kdr for a uniform electric field.
source_representation.source_points: All 516 immutable exterior QM-MEP validation points are used; no PCM surface, cavity, or continuum response is constructed or selected.
